story.quote: Built in a Gujarati kitchen. Tested in the gym.
paragraphs: Pratus started with a stubborn question: why did eating for performance mean giving up the food that made me who I am?

Every high-protein option was a chicken breast, a shake, or a sad bowl of quinoa. Nothing on the shelf looked like the plates at my parents’ table — rotli and shaak, thepla in a foil pack, paneer paratha on a Sunday.
So we rebuilt them. Same recipes, same hands, re-engineered for the macros athletes actually need. Vegetarian by default. Indian without apology. Culture that performs.

why.title: Us vs. them.
why.lead: Every option you had before made you choose. Protein or culture. Convenience or a real plate. We don’t.
why._rows: One row per feature. `them` is yes/no for each of the three columns above, in order. Pratus is always a yes.

mission.statement: Pratus Kitchen is a vegetarian, high-protein Indian meal company.
mission.copy: The food you grew up on was never the problem. The macros were. We rebuilt the plates our mothers made — rotli, thepla, paneer paratha — so they hit your protein goal, and never a compromise on taste.
